capabilities: Render the vault as an interactive 3D spherical graph with procedural terrain and atmosphere
Group notes into visual clusters based on their folders
Focus on a note's neighborhood with one to three connection hops
Search, filter, and rotate the sphere to locate and inspect notes
Open the underlying Markdown note from the graph details panel
extras: Also ships as a standalone browser prototype (Node.js 18+, Vite) that reads a local Markdown folder without Obsidian; all processing is local with no uploads.
intentEvidence: designed as an immersive alternative to the traditional Obsidian graph view
motivation: The author wants the vault to feel like a navigable world rather than a diagram, using a bounded sphere and procedural terrain to support spatial memory.
problem: Obsidian's graph view places notes on a flat canvas or unstructured cloud, offering little sense of place or spatial memory.

relations.evidence: beta releases are available through GitHub Releases and BRAT

summary: 3D knowledge graph that renders the vault as an interactive sphere with terrain, folder clusters, and link navigation.
